text:
maria: FYI acme-prod is seeing 503s across us-east for the last ~5m, CS on the hotline. Root logs show upstream infer worker SIGSEGV plus intermittent CUDA OOMs. :rotating_light:

derek: logs?

maria: pasted snippet:
```
[2026-03-17T08:13:02Z] infer-runner[pid=4221]: SIGSEGV at 0x7ffdeadbeef ip=0x7f3a2c...
[2026-03-17T08:13:02Z] nvml: Out Of Memory on device 0 (requested 2048MB)
```

derek: interesting, random addresses. Is this during model swap or heavy batch?

maria: customer load is steady high qps + some very large-context requests (~32k). Also a canary swap of model variant happened around 08:12.

oncall-ryan: I'm grabbing heapdumps + core. Starting node drain on that AZ to route traffic to standby.

support-esk: customers reporting 500s with "upstream inference error" and retries are blowing up billing for the tenant. CS on a call.

derek: can we repro locally? need repro steps to validate fix.

maria: repro attempt: ran long prompt + 120 concurrent streams with batchsize 8 and triggered a segfault after ~90s.

maria: repro commands:
```
ab -n 120 -c 120 http://hotrod-infer.local/generate -p "<<<32k prompt>>>"
# or
python tools/loadtest.py --concurrency 120 --seq-len 32768 --model redwood-xl-32k
```

infra-ivana: kernel stack from coredump shows invalid pointer deref inside the attention kernel, looks like kv-cache reallocation race when swapping models. CC runtime team.

derek: temporary mitigation: pause hot model-swap rollout and reduce max batchsize to 4 globally for hosted to avoid OOM spikes.

oncall-ryan: mitigation applied: rollout paused, cluster autoscaler max batchsize reduced, fallback routing enabled to model-compatible tier.

support-esk: notified customer, offered billing credits for retry storm. CS wants an ETA for a root-cause fix.

infra-ivana: collecting GPU coredumps and full logs, opened issue INFR-3248 with attached repro steps and logs. Working on a patch to make kv reallocation atomic.

derek: can we add a defensive null-check before the deref as a quick hotfix?

infra-ivana: yes, adding guard + forcing deterministic free ordering. Running unit + load tests now. If green, will land a canary tonight to 10% then ramp.

maria: thanks — please post links to the issue and the postmortem once available. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: deploy p12345 queued to canary, will roll to 10% once CI passes.

support-esk: CS will continue customer comms and log any auth/billing anomalies during the retry storm.

maria: tracking note: follow-up triage in #incidents in 30m to confirm patch results and rollback windows.
